Notes: Modelled as ordered message channel with admin/submit keys.
Aligns message metadata with consensus timestamps.
Datatype property capturing the canonical topic ID (shard.realm.num) for a ConsensusTopic; range xsd:string; analogous to hedera:hasAccountId on Account.
Datatype property capturing the consensus-assigned timestamp for a TopicMessage; range xsd:string in the native Hedera seconds.nanoseconds form; see also prov:generatedAtTime.
Object property linking a TopicMessage to the ConsensusTopic it belongs to; domain hedera:TopicMessage; range hedera:ConsensusTopic.
Object property relating an actor to a consensus topic under its control; domain hedera:Actor; range hedera:ConsensusTopic; inverse hedera:isTopicOf; parallels hedera:hasAccount.
Inverse of hedera:controlsTopic linking a consensus topic back to its controlling actor; domain hedera:ConsensusTopic; range hedera:Actor; parallels hedera:isAccountOf.
Key-granular subproperty of hedera:controlsTopic for the admin-key holder; entailed via property chain holdsKey o isAdminKeyOf; domain hedera:Actor; range hedera:ConsensusTopic.

Key-granular subproperty of hedera:controlsTopic for the submit-key holder (not "can submit": keyless topics are open); entailed via property chain holdsKey o isSubmitKeyOf; domain hedera:Actor; range hedera:ConsensusTopic.
Key-granular subproperty of hedera:controlsTopic for the HIP-991 fee-schedule-key holder; entailed via property chain holdsKey o isFeeScheduleKeyOf; domain hedera:Actor; range hedera:ConsensusTopic.
Key that authorises update/delete of a topic's custom fees (HIP-991); subclass of hedera:AccountKey alongside TopicAdminKey and TopicSubmitKey.
Object property linking a ConsensusTopic to its HIP-991 fee schedule key; subPropertyOf hedera:hasTopicKey; inverse hedera:isFeeScheduleKeyOf.
Inverse of hedera:hasAdminKey; second step of the controlsAdminKeyOf property chain.
Inverse of hedera:hasSubmitKey; second step of the controlsSubmitKeyOf property chain.
Inverse of hedera:hasFeeScheduleKey; second step of the controlsFeeScheduleKeyOf property chain.
Represents committee mandates assigning validator stewardship roles.
HIP-840 defines council responsibilities for onboarding validators.
Links to mirror datasets capturing record exports.
